prompt:
Use case: logo-brand.
Create ONE COMPLETELY NEW finished two-line title logo for the mobile game, using the attached approved muddy shoeprint only as the STYLE reference. Recreate the full logo as a new coherent image; do not just add a detached caption above the old image.

Text, EXACTLY with this capitalization and line break:
Viimeinen keisari
karkuteillä

The top line must read "Viimeinen keisari" (V-i-i-m-e-i-n-e-n space k-e-i-s-a-r-i), the lower line "karkuteillä" (k-a-r-k-u-t-e-i-l-l-ä). Include the distinct i dot and TWO distinct dots over ä. No other text, numbers, hyphen or punctuation. The ENTIRE game name must be very legible when the logo is shown about 350 pixels wide on a phone. Both lines large, bold and optically balanced; top line slightly smaller but still substantial. Bold blunt, slightly condensed letter shapes, positive DARK letters, not light knocked-out lettering. Generous clear space inside and between letters. Do not make the top line tiny, ornate, italic calligraphy or a different type style.

Appearance: a real wet dark umber/near-black muddy SOLE CONTACT PRINT stamped onto a surface, viewed flat directly overhead, with the two lines physically formed by the same shoe-sole lettering. Match the reference's irregular muddy transfer, subtle fine grit, rich dark text, fragmented narrow outsole silhouette and very sparse angular tread remnants. A single horizontal elongated shoe shape: narrower rounded heel at LEFT, subtle inward waist and broader rounded toe at RIGHT. Keep only a FEW broken pieces of the outer sole pattern so they suggest a shoe without competing with either line. A modest asymmetric scattering of small organic mud droplets and a few ragged splash marks outside the shoe, more near the heel and toe, as in the reference. Do not put splashes across letters or by the diacritic dots. The text dominates. The entire two-line title is ONE cohesive stamp inside the shoeprint impression.

Flat matte ink/mud contact-transfer graphic. No physical shoe, bevels, 3D piled mud, glossy rubber, heavy shadows, solid enclosing plaque, square background, paper or checkerboard. Truly transparent alpha everywhere without ink/mud, including inside counters and between tread fragments. All mud and all droplets comfortably inside the canvas; keep transparent padding on all four sides.

Output a single wide landscape transparent PNG, preferably 3072 x 1152 pixels, and at least 2048 pixels wide, approximately 2.7:1 overall. One logo only. Do not include a loading-screen scene, people, environment, a mockup, labels, watermark or comparison panel.
